rules.description: After a scholarship payment is made, the feedback mechanism shares information about the successful disbursal among banks, NPCI, PFMS, and NSP, and updates the user accounts of beneficiaries and the concerned ministries/departments.
rules.condition: When a scholarship payment has been made.
rules.outcome: Information regarding the successful disbursal is shared between banks, NPCI, PFMS, and NSP, and is reflected on the user accounts of beneficiaries/students and the concerned ministries/departments.
rules.evidence_quote: Once payment is made, the feedback mechanism will enable sharing of information between banks, NPCI, PFMS and NSP regarding successful disbursal of scholarships.
